decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The double accessdoorway to the reatil unit shall have a minimum clear width of 1800mm, and the single door will have a minimum clear opening width of 900mm and will remail level with the pavement.

Condition : 4 - AdvertisementsThe proposal hereby permitted refers only to the installation of the new shop front and does not give consent for the display of adverts. Any advert including fascia, hanging or projecting signs should not be displayed without the submission of a separate planning application.

Condition : 5 - Control of FumesThe five proposed condensers to be situated at the rear elevation of the property will be positioned at the highest feasible point on anti-vibration pads and shall be fully implemented before the A3 use opens to customers.

Condition : 6 - Informatives:
1		It is expected that during the construction of the approved work no materials or equipment should interfere with the use of the pathway by members of the public. You are advised that you contact the councils Highways licensing department on 020 8583 4863.
description: Installation of a new shop front and installation of 5 - new condensers to rear elevation of first floor and re-position of exhaust duct to terminate at second floor to existing shop
